description: Evidence-driven fault matrix for controlled lab failures.

entries.title: FortiGate policy mismatch
entries.symptom: Client reaches gateway but TCP/443 is denied
entries.firstEvidence: diagnose debug flow + policy log + sniffer on ingress/egress
entries.discriminatingTest: Run one flow from a known source IP and compare matched policy ID with intended rule
entries.resolution: Correct source/destination/service/object scope or policy order; verify counters increment on intended rule
entries.rollback: Restore previous policy snapshot and retest same 5-tuple

entries.title: FortiGate missing route
entries.symptom: Packet enters firewall but no forward path exists
entries.firstEvidence: get router info routing-table all + debug flow route lookup
entries.discriminatingTest: Compare intended prefix, longest match and next-hop reachability
entries.resolution: Restore connected/static/dynamic route or correct VRF/VDOM context
entries.rollback: Remove only the added route and return to previous routing table

entries.title: DHCP Offer absent
entries.symptom: Client broadcasts Discover but never receives Offer
entries.firstEvidence: capture UDP 67/68 on client VLAN and inspect relay/server counters
entries.discriminatingTest: Send a single DHCP Discover while observing both client VLAN and server side
entries.resolution: Fix scope exhaustion, relay address, VLAN path or server service
entries.rollback: Restore relay/scope configuration and renew lease

entries.title: DNS SERVFAIL
entries.firstEvidence: dig +trace or authoritative query plus resolver logs
entries.discriminatingTest: Query the same name against local recursive resolver and authoritative server
entries.resolution: Fix upstream delegation, DNSSEC or authoritative service issue identified by evidence

entries.title: OSPF stuck in ExStart
entries.firstEvidence: show ip ospf neighbor detail + MTU + packet capture of OSPF
entries.discriminatingTest: Compare interface MTU and DD packet negotiation on both sides
entries.resolution: Align MTU or explicitly use a lab-only workaround only when design permits

entries.title: TCP MSS/PMTUD black hole
entries.symptom: Small requests work but large responses stall
entries.firstEvidence: capture SYN/SYN-ACK MSS and ICMP too-big messages
entries.discriminatingTest: Compare path MTU and negotiated MSS; test a reduced MSS
entries.resolution: Fix PMTUD filtering or set an appropriate TCP MSS clamp at the tunnel edge
entries.rollback: Remove MSS change and restore MTU/ICMP behavior

entries.title: Unexpected STP root change
entries.symptom: Traffic path changes and topology-change events spike
entries.firstEvidence: show spanning-tree root/roles + MAC movement + BPDU events
entries.discriminatingTest: Compare bridge priority and received BPDUs on candidate root ports
entries.resolution: Restore intended root priority and enable edge-port protections where appropriate

entries.title: SNMP polling timeout
entries.symptom: NMS shows device unreachable while ICMP works
entries.discriminatingTest: Direct snmpget of sysName.0 from NMS host using same credentials/version
entries.resolution: Correct ACL, SNMP version/security parameters or agent state

entries.title: SIP call establishes but media is one-way
entries.symptom: 200 OK occurs but RTP is missing in one direction
entries.firstEvidence: SIP SDP addresses/ports + bidirectional RTP capture
entries.discriminatingTest: Compare advertised media address with reachable NAT-mapped address
entries.resolution: Correct NAT/SBC/media relay or SIP ALG behavior based on evidence
entries.rollback: Restore previous SBC/NAT policy and retest a single call

entries.title: IP camera online but no video
entries.symptom: Camera responds to ping but NVR has no stream
entries.firstEvidence: ONVIF discovery/RTSP TCP 554 capture and NVR camera status
entries.discriminatingTest: Open RTSP stream from isolated test client using camera credentials
entries.resolution: Correct codec/profile, credentials, stream URL or VLAN/PoE path
entries.rollback: Restore prior camera profile and NVR channel settings
